More real version: So far we have only used classical physics. Now for the quantum spookiness. In the quantum world we don't have colors, we have angles. You know those that go from 0 to 360 degrees. And for any angle we can measure if the particle is aligned with that angle or opposite of that angle. So we can ask: "is our particle 0 degrees or 180 degrees". Or we could ask "is our particle 30 degrees or 210 degrees".

Ok, so let's say you ask your particle "are you 0 degrees or 180 degrees?", and it says "I'm 0 degrees!". Then if I have a coupled particle and ask my particle "are you 0 degrees or 180 degrees?" it will say "I'm 0 degrees too!". So far all good. But what if I ask it "are you 10 degrees or 190 degrees?". Then since 10 degrees is kinda close to 0 degrees it will with high probability say "I'm 10 degrees!" but there is also a chance it says "I'm 190 degrees!"

Now the way people think you could maybe communicate is like this "hey banana, if everything is fine I will ask my particle if it's '90 or 270' and if I'm being killed by monsters I will ask my particle if 'it's 0 or 180'. Now the problem with this is that no matter which of those two questions I ask, and no matter which question you ask, the probabilities for you will be 50/50. To see this, let's say you ask "70 or 250?". Now let's say I asked "90 and 270?" If I get 90 then you will probably get 70, but if I get 270 then you will probably get 250. These possibilities cancel and means you have 50/50 of getting 70 or 250. But the exact same thing would have happened if I had asked "0 or 180". Since your probabilities are the same, you can't distinguish the two cases. You can't say 70 - probably fine, 250 probably being eaten alive."
